user.title: Nanoleaf Remote
user.description: Before continuing, remove the Remote from Apple Home: it only accepts one controller. Then choose the Remote and enter the 8-digit HomeKit setup code printed on it.

confirm.title: Pair {name}
confirm.description: Remove the Remote from Apple Home first: it only accepts one controller. Then enter the 8-digit HomeKit setup code printed on it.

error.device_not_found: The Remote is not visible to Home Assistant Bluetooth. Wake it by turning it and check the range of your Bluetooth adapter or proxy.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the Remote. Try again while turning it gently to keep it awake.
error.timeout: The pairing took too long. Try again.
error.invalid_setup_code: The setup code must contain 8 digits.
error.invalid_auth: The setup code was rejected. Check it against the label on the Remote.
error.already_paired: The Remote refuses new pairings. Remove it from Apple Home (or from any other controller) and try again.
error.too_many_attempts: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes before trying again.
error.busy: The Remote is busy. Try again in a moment.
error.pairing_failed: Pairing failed. Check the Home Assistant logs for details.
